collision_check: Searched 191 openkit-*/fbx for parchment|vellum|scrap|pumice|stretch|frame|hide|lunell. Near-misses: prop-parchment-sheet-stack (scribe, finished trimmed stack), prop-stretching-frame/prop-scraping-knife/prop-hide-pile (tanner), prop-sewing-frame (bookbinder), prop-scraping-knife-hw1 (horn-worker). No pumice, no sheet-blank, no prior parchment-maker pack.
judgment_calls: Sheet blank is a single untrimmed irregular 10-sided hide outline with darker uncut leg margins + chalk trim lines, laid; distinct from scribe's trimmed sheet stack and from book pages/scrolls

Stretching frame is an upright parchment herse (posts, rails, foot skids, 4 turning pegs + cords tensioning a hide) vs tanner's frame; floor-standing bottom_centre, back flat enough to sit against a wall
Knife is a crescent lunellum with central crosswise handle, unlike straight tanner/horn scrapers
Pumice block chamfered and top-tapered; dark worn spot reads as a thin line at render scale (kept)
Frame pegs changed from 6-seg cylinders to boxes to get 212->180 tris
Eye-check v1: lunellum segments mis-rotated (broken arc) + oversized handle -> fixed v2; v2 no floating parts, crescent continuous, hide connected to posts via cords
